Market today: Mixed signals. Family offices are bullish, but Fed talk about raising rates is a big red flag for your growth/tech names, especially with margin. AI news around Nvidia is positive for chips.

Your holdings: SOXL (-52.51%) and SPAL (-40.16%) are bleeding hard. These are leveraged, decay, and on margin, so drops are amplified. SMH (-10.72%) and QQQI (-3.21%) also need attention per the scanner.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Fed commentary for any further hawkish signals. Also, watch for any follow-through on the positive AI news for chip stocks.

Bottom line: Protect your capital on leveraged losers and respect your stops, especially with rate hike threats looming.
plays: SOXL: This leveraged ETF is down over 50%. Consider trimming or exiting if it continues to fall, given its decay and your margin exposure.
SPAL: Another leveraged ETF, down over 40%. Review your stop at 21.38; this one moves fast and decays.
SMH: Your stop at 540 is critical. Respect it to prevent further losses on this chip ETF.
